description: The shared, domain-neutral tokens every branch can reference by path ({core.<path>}): identity, palette, typography, voice and marks. Defaults are a plain, conventional look; the shipped hazard-protocol theme sets the house values.

classes.cosmetic: How things look in every domain: free to change; a change here reaches every branch that references the token.
classes.brand: Marks, fonts and brand mode: each asset token resolves only to a registered asset whose license is settled, and a client project may turn house marks off with brand.mode.

tokens.title: Words for the look
tokens.description: Three to five words that describe the look, read by the agent before it styles anything in any domain.

tokens.title: Reference images
tokens.description: Example image files (in an examples/ folder of the style, with captions) that show the look; the examples folders are searched as well.

tokens.title: Accent
tokens.description: The one accent color: callouts, highlights, functional emphasis.

tokens.title: Accent, lit band
tokens.description: The accent's light band (renders, hover, lit faces).

tokens.title: Accent, shadow band
tokens.description: The accent's dark band (shadow faces, small accent text, accent edge lines).

tokens.title: Accent use
tokens.description: functional: the accent marks something that matters (an indicator, a release, a warning, a primary callout) and nothing else; free: no rule.

tokens.title: Neutral 100
tokens.description: N-scale gray, lightest used step.

tokens.title: Neutral 200
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 400
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 500
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 600
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 700
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 800
tokens.description: N-scale gray.

tokens.title: Neutral 950
tokens.description: N-scale gray, darkest used step.

tokens.title: Background
tokens.description: Page, canvas or render background.

tokens.title: Primary body
tokens.description: The color of the main subject: the primary part, the main body in a render.

tokens.title: Secondary body
tokens.description: Supporting and structural parts.

tokens.title: Ink
tokens.description: Text, outlines and edge lines on light grounds.

tokens.title: Muted
tokens.description: Secondary callouts, captions and rules.

tokens.title: Warning
tokens.description: Warnings and errors only; never decoration.

tokens.title: Display face
tokens.description: Titles, tags and marks set in type (a CAD emboss, a document heading, a render title).

tokens.title: Body face
tokens.description: Running text and labels.

tokens.title: Mono face
tokens.description: Numbers, identifiers, serial numbers, code.

tokens.title: Display weight
tokens.description: Weight of the display face (CSS weight scale).

tokens.title: Display font file
tokens.description: The registered font file for the display face (asset id), so a domain that needs outlines (a CAD emboss, polygon silkscreen) uses the same face.

tokens.title: Body font file
tokens.description: The registered font file for the body face (asset id).

tokens.title: Case of tags
tokens.description: Case of short identifiers and tags in every domain (group titles, part labels, callout identifiers, embossed text).

tokens.title: Case of descriptions
tokens.description: Case of descriptive text (captions, callout descriptions).

tokens.title: Callout routing
tokens.description: orthogonal: leader lines run horizontal and vertical with right-angle bends, in renders, documents and drawings alike.

tokens.title: Callout terminal
tokens.description: What a leader line ends in at the object.

tokens.title: Brand mode
tokens.description: house: the house marks apply; client: only the maker mark, never the house name or logo (check the contract); neutral: no marks.

tokens.title: Logo
tokens.description: The logo asset every domain places (silkscreen, emboss, document header, render).

tokens.title: Wordmark
tokens.description: The wordmark asset, when one is registered.

tokens.title: Mark clear space
tokens.description: Clear zone around a mark, as a share of the mark's height (1 means a clear band as wide as the mark is tall).

tokens.title: Motto
tokens.description: A motto a domain may set as text; set in the user's own layer, empty in shipped themes.
